name: PruneManagedBackups
transaction_boundary: one bounded prune command selects a deterministic eligible candidate set, moves each selected artifact to a same-directory deterministic quarantine before the authoritative transaction, then one LLD-01 UnitOfWork revalidates the complete set and atomically records COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 receipt, catalog state/revision changes, audit event/result refs and commit; quarantine deletion is post-commit technical cleanup
authoritative_reads: verified/restored managed backup catalog ordered by created_at_utc DESC, backup_id DESC
artifact digest/existence and deterministic quarantine state
guards: each candidate lies strictly beyond retention_count under deterministic catalog ordering
at least one non-pruned verified/restored restorable backup remains after the entire proposed prune set
every candidate final artifact or deterministic quarantine file matches the catalog digest before authoritative mutation
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 over command_id + retention_count; committed replay returns recorded pruned_backup_ids and reconciles any surviving quarantine files without selecting new candidates; same command_id with a different request hash is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
receipt_order: replay -> compute deterministic candidate set -> verify digests/restorable survivor -> atomically rename each candidate final artifact to deterministic same-directory quarantine name bound to command_id and backup_id -> BEGIN LLD-01 UnitOfWork -> replay check again + revalidate exact candidate catalog revisions/quarantine digests/survivor invariant -> command_receipt -> set exact candidate catalog rows state=pruned and increment revision -> security.managed_backup_pruned audit with deterministic audit_event_results for every pruned backup_id -> COMMIT -> best-effort delete quarantine files; if transaction does not commit, restore all quarantine files to their canonical final names before returning failure
mutations: selected managed_backup_catalog rows transition verified|restored -> pruned
each selected catalog row revision increments exactly once
one command_receipt and one required prune audit event with immutable result refs for the committed candidate set
revision_effects: each catalog row newly transitioned to pruned increments revision by 1; committed replay increments nothing; no security_revision or owning-domain revision changes
post_commit_work: delete committed quarantine files best-effort; startup/job recovery scans only deterministic managed-backup prune quarantine names, verifies backup_id/command_id/digest, restores quarantine to final name when no matching committed prune receipt/catalog state exists, and deletes quarantine when matching committed prune state exists
rules: never prune an unverified newest backup as justification
never delete or quarantine the last verified/restored restorable managed backup
database catalog/receipt commit is authoritative prune truth; filesystem absence alone never establishes prune success
a missing final artifact with no valid deterministic quarantine is an explicit BACKUP_NOT_RESTORABLE/IO failure and is never converted into fabricated prune success
quarantine rename and rollback use the same filesystem/directory so no cross-volume copy is treated as atomic

no ordinary cancellation point exists between first quarantine rename and transaction resolution; cancellation is observed before choreography starts or after it reaches a recoverable committed/rolled-back boundary
operator-selected portable backups are never candidates
